components.name: O Arcade Buzzer
components.css: .ds-btn-o { background: #2ee55b; color: #04190a; border: 4px solid #1ad7e6; padding: 14px 18px; font-weight: 700; box-shadow: inset 0 4px 0 #8dffab, 0 8px 0 #0e7b34; transition: transform 0.08s steps(2); } .ds-btn-o:hover { filter: brightness(1.07); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-o:active { transform: translateY(5px); box-shadow: inset 0 4px 0 #8dffab, 0 3px 0 #0e7b34; }

components.name: X Arcade Buzzer
components.css: .ds-btn-x { background: #d92332; color: #f4f7ff; border: 4px solid #f97316; padding: 14px 18px; font-weight: 700; box-shadow: inset 0 4px 0 #ff7580, 0 8px 0 #7c111b; transition: transform 0.08s steps(2); } .ds-btn-x:hover { filter: brightness(1.07); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-x:active { transform: translateY(5px); box-shadow: inset 0 4px 0 #ff7580, 0 3px 0 #7c111b; }

components.name: CRT Dialogue Box
components.description: Stepped pixel corner-framed question and explanation stage.
components.css: .ds-dialogue { background: #101836; color: #f4f7ff; border: 4px solid #1ad7e6; padding: 24px 30px; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 4px #090e21, inset 0 0 0 6px #1d5ce5, 0 8px 0 #050814; }

narrative.overview: 권리ON turns a labor-rights booth into a crisp phosphor-black CRT arcade cabinet built around an immediate Question 1 RPG/quiz dialogue frame, oversized tactile O and X push-buttons, faceted diamond stage gems, and instant booth turnover controls.
keyCharacteristics: Strict 16-color sprite palette over Phosphor Black (#060811) and Deep CRT Navy (#090e21).
Crisp 90-degree stepped pixel corners (0px border radius throughout) and hard px bevels.
Toggleable CRT scanline overlay (CRT ON/OFF) and Web Audio 8-bit synthesizer (SFX ON/OFF).

rules.name: The Power-Gold Reserve Rule
rules.body: Gold (#fcd31d) marks only scores, active progress, rank crests, and primary advancement/reset buttons.

rules.name: The Polarity Law
rules.body: Green (#2ee55b) owns O and right verdicts; Red (#d92332) owns X and wrong verdicts.

dos: Do keep O and X buzzers large, side-by-side, and free of line-wrapping (white-space: nowrap).
Do preserve CRT ON/OFF and SFX ON/OFF controls in the top HUD for bright booths and quiet spaces.
Do keep 1-tap BOOTH RESET accessible in both the bottom booth strip and end screen.
donts: Don't introduce soft rounded corners (border-radius > 0), gradients-as-text, or off-palette hues.
Don't obscure Hangul explanations with opaque scanlines — keep scanline opacity subtle (0.24).
Don't let the desktop result screen overflow 800px outer viewport height.
